name: Goldenhills Plantation
note: Each container takes the item categories listed (see Categories/00_Default.json); ignored ones are never used. Anything without a container of its own goes to the master, the chest. The bookshelves are scripted and the pantry is the farm's: books, food, ammo, keys and most crafting materials go to the master.
author: Dova Stash
